1.en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
1.tj: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ ١

2.en: And We removed from you your burden

3.en: Which had weighed upon your back
3.tj: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ ٣

4.en: And raised high for you your repute.

5.en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
5.tj: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ٥

6.tj: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ٦

7.en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
7.tj: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ ٧

8.en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
8.tj: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب ٨
